title: One answer set for every marked item
statement: Before a marker scores students, probe every marked item with the same set of answers, among them partial, wrong, misspelled, negated and empty ones, and the hint echoed back.
example: One probe sent 4 kinds of answer to each of 4 marked items: a full answer, one part only, a plausible wrong one and the hint echoed back.
detail: A live probe of a reading engine's marker sent four answers to each of four open items, a full answer, one meeting one criterion only, a plausible wrong one and the hint echoed back, and all 16 verdicts were right (`grade3-reading/artifacts/peter-pan-standing-2026-09-11/readiness-l5-2026-09-17/sim-review/lens-judge-probe.md`). A set of verification proposals adds a correct meaning with a typo, nonsense resembling a keyword, a valid synonym, a fluent wrong answer, a partial answer and a contradictory premise (`grade3-reading/artifacts/feedback-devfactory-2026-09-10/analysis-current-courses/VERIFICATION-PROPOSALS.md`). A closing-question pattern shows why a negation belongs in the set: matching on 'broken' passes 'trust can never be broken', the opposite of the answer (`grade3-reading/artifacts/feedback-closing-questions-2026-09-24/Closing_Questions_Pattern.txt`). The full set is the ideal answer, a partial one, plausible and fluent wrong ones, a misspelled right one, a synonym, the hint echoed back, the answer's negation, keyword-stuffed nonsense, an off-topic one and an empty one.
against: Of these, only the four-answer probe was run, and its expected verdicts were set by agents, not a person; the longer list is a proposal marked not executed (`grade3-reading/artifacts/feedback-devfactory-2026-09-10/analysis-current-courses/VERIFICATION-PROPOSALS.md`). The faults were narrow ones: 114 of the 117 judge cases written for that build were right before the fix, and all three wrong ones were of the one kind (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0229-closing-questions-build-2026-09-25.qmd`, line 96).
